required_changes.requirement: Record CAPABILITY_REPAIR_BASELINE_V1 as a distinct forward baseline. Do not require, retry, or claim strict historical Foundation-V2 equivalence. Preserve prior reconstruction and post-hoc artifacts as historical evidence only, and do not use Directive 027 as a blocker for this stage.

On the intended RunPod mount, enumerate and hash the exact base-model config, tokenizer files, every expected base-model weight shard and index, adapter config, adapter weights, and any generation configuration. Bind the selected checkpoint directory and reject missing, extra, substituted, unresolved, or mismatched files before model-library import.

Create one immutable launch contract binding this directive and reviewed brief hash, baseline identity SHA256 d1ca26d0a5f1651d2987e4a0555a4751caa1ca1785f5d46e77ab83fc3dacaf3b, complete checkpoint manifest, exact TARGET_DEV and RETENTION_SENTINEL paths and hashes, exact inference contract and executable hashes, exact interpreter and argv, deterministic environment, runtime cap, a fresh nonce, and absent fresh output and receipt paths. The contract must explicitly forbid training data and FINAL_AUDIT_SEALED.

Replace the boolean-only authorization check with exact directive and launch-contract verification. Before importing model libraries, verify the live source commit, executable and dependency hashes, full checkpoint identity, both allowed dataset hashes and roles, inference contract, prompt and parser identity, nonce freshness, output isolation, and absence of all forbidden inputs. Atomically consume the nonce and always emit a terminal receipt.

The authorized future run must evaluate exactly the frozen 192-row TARGET_DEV surface and 96-row RETENTION_SENTINEL once, with deterministic decoding and fixed denominators. It must not construct an optimizer or LoRA, mutate weights, adapt curriculum, access FINAL_AUDIT, train on diagnostic Gold, overwrite outputs, or automatically launch a follow-on repair round. Partial or capped output must be labeled PARTIAL and must not be interpreted as a complete profile.

Add dummy CPU tests for exact data-hash enforcement, forbidden-data denial independent of filenames, model and adapter manifest mismatch, source or executable substitution, command and environment substitution, nonce replay, existing outputs, runtime cap, incomplete denominators, and complete success and failure receipts. Run a read-only RunPod preflight through the last step before model import and record local=origin=RunPod source parity.

Return a new hashed launch-readiness brief directly to the Director in this same Controller cycle with the frozen contract, tests, and fresh remote preflight evidence. Do not request Supervisor handoff. Do not load the model or begin GPU inference or training before a later explicit Director directive reviews and authorizes the exact package.
